relations.text: 自社製でないエンジンを購入している
relations.text_en: PACCAR buys the engines it does not make itself from Cummins

source.label: PACCAR 10-K(December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Engines not manufactured by the Company are purchased from Cummins Inc. (Cummins).

relations.text: EVEエナジー等と商用車用電池を共同生産する
relations.text_en: PACCAR and Cummins have partnered with others to produce commercial vehicle batteries in a 21-gigawatt hour factory

source.label: PACCAR 10-K(December 31, 2025)
source.quote: PACCAR, Cummins, Daimler Trucks and EVE Energy have partnered to produce state-of-the-art commercial vehicle batteries in a 21-gigawatt hour (GWh) factory in Marshall County, Mississippi.
